prompt:
These are clusters of opening messages customers sent to Apple's
support account on Twitter. Each cluster is a group of semantically similar
messages, with the examples closest to the cluster centre shown.

Name each cluster as a customer-support intent.

Rules:
- name: snake_case, 1-3 words, describing what the CUSTOMER WANTS, not the
  device or feature involved. Prefer "battery_drain" over "iphone_problem".
- is_support_request: false for venting, jokes, insults, feature requests and
  general commentary with no answerable request. These are common here and are
  a legitimate category, not noise to be forced into a support intent.
- coherent: false if the examples plainly do not share one intent. Say so
  rather than inventing a label that papers over a mixed cluster.
- merge_with: if two clusters are the same intent, name the other one. Else "".

Return one object per cluster, in cluster_id order.

description.description: one sentence, what the customer wants

is_support_request.description: false for venting, jokes, feature requests and general commentary

coherent.description: false if these examples do not share a single intent

merge_with.description: name of another cluster this duplicates, or empty string

response.name: fix_keyboard_autocorrect
response.description: The customer wants the bug where typing 'I' produces an 'A' and symbol fixed.

response.name: fix_autocorrect_bug

response.name: ios_performance_issues
response.description: The customer is complaining about battery drain, freezing, and poor performance after updating to iOS 11.

response.name: fix_question_mark_glitch
response.description: The customer wants the autocorrect question mark box symbol bug fixed.

response.name: fix_device_crashing
response.description: The customer needs help fixing an iPhone that repeatedly crashes, restarts, or shows a black loading screen.

response.name: complaint_hardware_support
response.description: The customer is venting about recurring hardware failures, repair delays, and poor customer service.

response.name: fix_battery_drain
response.description: The customer needs help or is complaining about rapid battery drain and sudden power drops on their iPhone.

response.name: media_app_help
response.description: The customer needs support or is giving feedback regarding iTunes, Apple Music, and Podcasts.

response.name: fix_keyboard_glitch
response.description: The customer wants Apple to resolve the 'I' autocorrect keyboard glitch.

response.description: The customer is expressing anger and frustration about an iOS update causing phone freezes and glitches.

response.name: update_error_persists
response.description: The customer is reporting that an error or popup persists even after installing an iOS update.

response.name: generic_bug_venting
